column1: # Stars! per-component base-stat tables, extracted from stars.exe
# Source: one contiguous read-only data block embedded in the client's component-resolver
#   code segment (NE segment 2). Segment-relative offset -> file offset = 0x3240 + offset.
# Universal record layout: +0 ordinal(u16) | +2..+7 six tech-level prerequisites
#   | +44 ironium | +46 boranium | +48 germanium | +50 icon index | +52.. category stats
# Ordinal (+0) vs the idx column below: idx is the 0-based position of the record within its own
#   category table. The stored +0 ordinal is idx+1 for every component category (1..count), i.e. it
#   is 1-based and never 0. Hull records differ: they store a unified hull index instead. Ship
#   hulls (0x4000) store 0..31, equal to idx, and starbase chassis (0x0400) store 32..36, so the
#   37 hull records share one index space (starbase idx 0..4 = stored 32..36). Verified against
#   the raw bytes of all 239 records.
# Engines: +52 special-behaviour selector, +54..+74 fuel usage indexed by warp 0..10.
# All multi-byte fields are little-endian 16-bit unsigned unless noted.
# Hull records additionally carry a slot array at +58 (4 bytes/entry:
#   u16 allowed-category bitmask, u8 reserved(always 0), u8 slot capacity), terminated
#   by a zero mask; +122 = slot count; +123.. = designer-diagram display metadata.
